name: Radon Number / VC Dimension (logarithmic)
details: For every finite binary class with positive VC dimension, $\mathrm{Rad}(\mathcal H)\geq\lfloor\log_2(2\,\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)+2)\rfloor\geq\log_2\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)$.
proof: The cited theorem gives the displayed floor-log lower bound for every class. Since $\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)\geq1$ in the nontrivial case, it immediately implies the recorded logarithmic relation; when VC dimension is zero the logarithmic statement is vacuous.
witness_verification: For the full cube, Radon number is $\lfloor\log_2(2n+2)\rfloor$ while VC dimension is $n$, so no reverse affine-linear bound can hold.
